vocabulary_loinc_components.about: LOINC 'Has component' of every LOINC concept the A28 tests read (the members of every real concept set holding 3005446, 3007070 or 40758413 in the 2026-09-12 delivery, the 2026-09-18_verify DELIVERY and the 2026-10-12 candidate, plus the lint tests' LDL/HbA1c/systolic ids, plus 3030989, the second LOINC test of HbA1 total). A non-LOINC id has no row.
vocabulary_loinc_components.query: SELECT c.concept_id, x.concept_id FROM synthea23m.concept c JOIN synthea23m.concept_relationship r ON r.concept_id_1 = c.concept_id AND r.invalid_reason IS NULL AND r.relationship_id = 'Has component' JOIN synthea23m.concept x ON x.concept_id = r.concept_id_2 AND x.vocabulary_id = 'LOINC' WHERE c.concept_id = ANY(%s) AND c.vocabulary_id = 'LOINC'
